## List scheduled social media posts

### How it works

1. Runs when you click Execute Workflow.
2. Lists posts from SocialRobot with optional filters.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node and connect your SocialRobot API credential (API key: socialrobot.io, Scheduler -> API Keys).
- [ ] Optionally set the status, platform, and date filters.

### Customization

Adjust the filters to list exactly the posts you care about. Run it any time to post, or connect a Schedule Trigger to automate it. Everything runs inside your own n8n workspace, so you can change any step after import. Run it once with a test post to confirm every node behaves as expected before you rely on it. You can duplicate the workflow to try variations without touching the original.

## List posts

Lists posts from SocialRobot with optional filters.
